# A grid example streams 50,000 rows and shows them arriving

Please comment to claim before starting; check current assignees and linked PRs.

## Context

New example 6 of the Grid & Table slate ([#21142](https://github.com/neomjs/neo/issues/21142#issuecomment-6924949418)), a leaf of #21175 (the Grid & Table group, under #21140). The visitor's question: what does a user see while 50,000 rows arrive?

No `good first issue` label: the stream's source is settled at intake (The Fix, step 1).

## The Problem

The engine can parse a response as it arrives and hand rows to the grid in chunks, so the first rows are usable before the last ones are loaded. The Streaming guide describes it. No example and no app of this repository uses it, and the grid's footer toolbar has a progress hook that nothing fills. A visitor cannot see the one behaviour that makes a large first load feel fast.

## The Architectural Reality

- `src/data/parser/Stream.mjs` and `src/data/connection/Stream.mjs`; the guide is `learn/guides/datahandling/Streaming.md` (the store's configuration, the JSONL format, progressive loading).
- `src/grid/footer/Toolbar.mjs`: the store's `progress` event calls `onStoreProgress(data)` (`:56`, `:89`), which is empty and meant to be overridden.
- A store reports `isStreaming` while a stream runs (`src/data/Store.mjs:944`).
- Searched on `dev` `c40689ef53`: no file under `examples/` or `apps/` imports the stream parser or the stream connection, or overrides `onStoreProgress`.
- `examples/grid/headerGroups` is the model for the page. Placement: a sibling folder `examples/grid/<feature>/`.
- A data file of 50,000 rows would weigh several megabytes in the repository and in the package (`check-size` runs on every pull request).
- Design authority: n/a, a new example.

## The Fix

1. **The stream is generated inside the example**, in chunks with a short pause between them, so the arrival is visible at any network speed and the example runs from a static host. Intended shape: a connection of the example's own that feeds the stream parser. Confirm at intake that the pipeline takes it; if not, file the gap and say so here.
2. **A new folder `examples/grid/streaming`**: a grid with a footer toolbar that overrides `onStoreProgress` and shows the count rising to 50,000, and a "Load again" button.
3. **One line says what to do**, for example "Scroll while the rows arrive."
4. A new catalog record with the group `grid-table`, and a `scope` that says the stream is generated in the example.

## Acceptance Criteria

- [ ] Rows are on screen and the grid scrolls while the store still reports `isStreaming`; a spec under `test/playwright/e2e/grid/` asserts a row count above zero and below 50,000 mid-stream.
- [ ] The footer shows the loaded count rising and ends at 50,000.
- [ ] "Load again" repeats the run from an empty grid.
- [ ] The PR says what the grid allows during the stream (scrolling, sorting, selecting), as observed.
- [ ] The pull request adds no data file larger than 50 KB.
- [ ] 1440 × 900 and 390 × 844; both themes.
- [ ] **Look:** three frames (start, mid-stream, done) at both sizes are on the PR, and the design seat reads them before code review.
- [ ] A catalog cover is shot mid-stream with the producer of #20679 and is on `neomjs/pages` `main` before this PR merges: `publishes()` (`apps/portal/model/Example.mjs:120`) drops a record without `image`, and the family case of `TabContainerController.spec.mjs` turns red on one. That spec's covered ids and totals are recounted against the `dev` this PR rebases on.
- [ ] If the data is generated, it is seeded, so the first frame, the cover and any spec that names first-frame content are the same on every load.

## Out of Scope

Engine changes to the stream parser, the connection or the footer toolbar; a real streaming endpoint; virtualising more than the grid already does.

## Avoided Traps

- **A fast local file.** It arrives in one frame and shows nothing.
- **A spinner until everything is there.** The proof is that the first rows are usable early.
- **A large JSONL file in the repository.**

### @neo-gemini-maryam - 2026-11-19T03:33:34Z

Claiming this lane (`@neo-gemini-maryam`).

Verified at intake against `origin/dev`:
- **Parent Epic review:** https://github.com/neomjs/neo/issues/21175#issuecomment-6936466827 (`@neo-opus-ada`) & Look protocol https://github.com/neomjs/neo/issues/21175#issuecomment-6937324027 (`@neo-fable-clio`).
- **Pipeline compatibility (Fix step 1):** `Neo.data.Pipeline#runStages` invokes `connection.read(params)` and passes `{stream, total}` straight into `Neo.data.parser.Stream#read`, which emits byte `progress` events and chunked `data` events that `Neo.data.Store#load` relays into `isStreaming` and `Neo.grid.footer.Toolbar#onStoreProgress` — zero `src/` changes required.
- **Seeded determinism:** Reusing `createSeededRandom` (`src/util/Random.mjs`) so all 50,000 rows, the cover frame, and specs see identical first-frame rows across every load.
